triples.relationship: the Lord raises a storm at sea
triples.rationale: Jonah's ship is endangered when the Lord stirs up a wind and a great surge arises at sea. The psalm's account of seafarers likewise attributes a storm wind and rising waves to the Lord's command.
triples.source_text: The Lord stirred up a wind upon the sea, and there was a great surge on the sea; the ship was in danger of being shattered.

target_units.text: Those going down into the sea in ships, doing work on many waters,
they saw the Lord’s works and His wonders in the depth.
He spoke, and a storm wind stood, and its waves were raised.
